skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply auditing knowledge and related fields to plan overall audits, design and execute financial statement audit procedures based on risk assessment.
Identify and assess risk factors affecting the quality of financial statement audits and internal controls.
Evaluate and improve internal control systems in audit processes.
Collect and analyze audit evidence to support audit objectives.
Prepare and present audit opinions in standard audit reports.
Adhere to laws, regulations, and professional ethics in audit processes.
Apply sampling methods in audit procedures.
Understand and apply financial reporting standards and practices.
Analyze and solve complex audit problems.
Effectively communicate audit findings and recommendations.
